Element.attribute: This work product is a succinct report of test execution results which allows project sponsors to gauge solution quality and to make an informed decision to transition to the target solution. Additionally, stakeholders use the information in this artifact to assess outstanding risks and determine a level of confidence in the quality of the target solution.

• Some organizations may a have a preferred template since this artifact is often used to communicate test progress to a larger audience outside of the test effort. Check with stakeholders for any existing templates.

This work product serves the following purposes:

• Communicate test execution results for stakeholder review and assessment
• Recommend future testing actions seeking stakeholder approval

Topics covered in this artifact include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Summarized test results and key metrics in relation to exit criteria
  • Evaluation of solution quality based on test results
  • Mitigated and unmitigated risks achieved by test efforts
  • Recommendations for future testing actions
